reopen_gate: materially superior replacement with executable evidence

decisions.title: Human Showrunner remains final creative/governance authority
decisions.decision: Human approval/override is explicit, auditable, and cannot be replaced by autonomous agent mutation.
decisions.rationale: Prevents silent authority drift while preserving automation.

decisions.title: Exactly one commit authority per authoritative state family
decisions.decision: Every authoritative state family has exactly one formal commit authority; other systems may only read/propose/approve according to R2.2.
decisions.rationale: Prevents conflicting stores and multi-agent write races.

decisions.title: Five authority planes
decisions.decision: Freeze Factual Authority, Narrative Authority, Authorial Intent, Production Authority, and Runtime Authority as distinct planes.
decisions.rationale: R1 evidence showed the former three-plane model was insufficient for factual truth and authorial-plan separation.

decisions.title: Candidate is never Canon
decisions.decision: Drafts, simulations, extracted changes, reviews, and generated candidates remain non-authoritative until an explicit transaction commits them.
decisions.rationale: Separates creative exploration from truth mutation.

decisions.title: NarrativePlan is separate from Canon
decisions.decision: Future authorial intent is stored in NarrativePlan/SceneContract, not as established world truth.
decisions.rationale: Prevents planned future events from contaminating current Canon.

decisions.title: KnowledgeState is first-class
decisions.decision: Who knows, suspects, falsely believes, or does not know a proposition is explicit authoritative state.
decisions.rationale: Prevents secret leakage and makes epistemic continuity mechanically testable.
reopen_conditions: materially superior representation with executable evidence

decisions.title: NarrativeContextCompiler is R2 core
decisions.decision: Authoritative context selection and epistemic filtering belong to the R2-owned NarrativeContextCompiler.
decisions.rationale: Donor context systems are useful but cannot define authoritative visibility rules.

decisions.title: NarrativeChangeSet is distinct from CanonDelta
decisions.decision: NarrativeChangeSet describes inferred changes from prose; CanonDelta is the explicit authoritative mutation proposal.
decisions.rationale: Separates extraction uncertainty from intended truth mutation.

decisions.title: Adaptation uses explicit branch/overlay lineage
decisions.decision: Medium adaptation never silently mutates source Canon; it uses parent-linked AdaptationBranch plus AdaptationMap.
decisions.rationale: Allows screenplay/audio variants while preserving source IP truth.

decisions.title: Factual truth and fiction truth remain distinct
decisions.decision: Factual content uses ResearchPack/ClaimLedger/Evidence; fiction uses Canon/Epistemic. They converge only at ScriptLikeArtifact/SceneSpec/ShotSpec.
decisions.rationale: Avoids forcing evidence truth into fiction semantics.

decisions.title: ArcReel-derived Host is primary runtime
decisions.decision: ArcReel-derived Host owns PostgreSQL, runtime tasks, queue, provider execution, Artifact Manifest, currency, provenance, recovery, idempotency, cost, review, and export.
decisions.rationale: R1.8 target-Ubuntu evidence passed source, PostgreSQL, restart, fault/recovery, idempotency, and backup/restore checks.

decisions.title: Use PostgreSQL from Host fork start
decisions.decision: The R2 Host fork starts on PostgreSQL rather than SQLite as the production development baseline.
decisions.rationale: R1.8 validated PostgreSQL migrations and restart health on the target machine.

decisions.title: Extend ArcReel Artifact Manifest; no parallel artifact registry
decisions.decision: R2 content lineage extends ArcReel Artifact Manifest instead of introducing a second authoritative artifact registry.
decisions.rationale: Avoids dual artifact truth and reuses verified ArcReel currency/provenance machinery.

decisions.title: No second general media queue
decisions.decision: Provider execution, durable task recovery, deduplication, and cancellation stay in ArcReel runtime.
decisions.rationale: A second queue would duplicate the strongest verified ArcReel capability.

decisions.title: DirectorAdapter is format-sensitive
decisions.decision: Use TakeDirector for fiction/cinematic, OpenMontageDirector for general content, and ArcReelNativeDirector as fallback.
decisions.rationale: R1.6 showed take is not universal and OpenMontage has stronger general-content scene planning.
reopen_conditions: measured inferior director quality for target format

decisions.title: Shot readiness is distinct from content status and runtime task status
decisions.decision: ShotPreparationService produces ProductionBinding and ProductionReadiness independently of creative approval and runtime tasks.
decisions.rationale: Prevents expensive generation with unresolved production prerequisites.

decisions.title: VisualIdentityProfile is first-class production state
decisions.decision: Character visual identity, look locks, and production variants are explicit production bindings, separate from Canon identity.
decisions.rationale: Improves continuity without contaminating Canon with production asset paths.
reopen_conditions: materially superior representation with executable evidence

decisions.title: Previous-frame chaining is conditional
decisions.decision: Use prior approved end-frame as a continuity binding only when the continuity segment and provider capability justify it.
decisions.rationale: Preserves continuity without over-constraining every shot.

decisions.title: ProductionBinding is the semantic-to-production bridge
decisions.decision: All semantic entities/assets needed for production are connected through ProductionBinding rather than direct asset fields in Canon/ShotSpec.
decisions.rationale: Keeps semantic truth and production variants decoupled.

decisions.title: Method before provider
decisions.decision: Choose REUSE/STOCK/SCREEN_CAPTURE/DETERMINISTIC/GENERATED_IMAGE/GENERATED_VIDEO/COMPOSITE before provider/model selection.
decisions.rationale: Encodes reuse-first economics and avoids provider-driven creative architecture.

decisions.title: One normalized CapabilityRegistry
decisions.decision: Business routing reads one R2 CapabilityRegistry normalized from ArcReel, DC-Media, OpenMontage and local/deterministic capabilities.
decisions.rationale: Prevents multiple competing provider catalogs in business logic.

decisions.title: PromptPlan is separate from ProviderRequest
decisions.decision: Butterfly-derived PromptCompiler produces provider-neutral PromptPlan; provider adapters produce exact ProviderRequest payloads.
decisions.rationale: Keeps stable creative semantics independent of vendor API.

decisions.title: SceneSpec and ShotSpec are provider-neutral
decisions.decision: Stable production semantic contracts cannot contain provider/model/endpoint/API payload/provider job identity.
decisions.rationale: Allows routing and runtime changes without rewriting creative semantics.

decisions.title: Content fingerprint is distinct from execution fingerprint
decisions.decision: Artifact currency uses semantic/content dependencies; provider/model/seed/resolution belong to execution provenance and candidate comparison.
decisions.rationale: Provider changes should not automatically stale valid content.

decisions.title: ApprovedMaster requires explicit selection
decisions.decision: A successful generation is not an approved master; selection/approval is explicit and failed later generations preserve the existing master.
decisions.rationale: Protects usable production state and separates generation from editorial authority.

decisions.title: Creative Canvas is exploration-only until PROMOTE
decisions.decision: DramaClaw-derived canvas cannot directly mutate production authority; explicit audited PROMOTE creates formal production artifacts.
decisions.rationale: Preserves experimentation without state contamination.
reopen_conditions: verified UX blocker requiring a different promotion boundary

decisions.title: Director World is deferred advanced spatial planning
decisions.decision: DramaClaw Director World/3D spatial planning is deferred until advanced creative workbench phase.
decisions.rationale: High value but not required for first implementation milestone.

decisions.title: OpenMontage/Remotion is primary deterministic composition path
decisions.decision: Use Remotion for general mixed compositions; ArcReel/FFmpeg retain media mechanics and drama assembly; HyperFrames stays specialized.
decisions.rationale: Matches donor strengths and avoids replacing proven FFmpeg/runtime mechanics.

decisions.title: Learning produces recommendations, not authority mutation
decisions.decision: Analytics/Learning can recommend experiments, routing or policy changes but cannot directly mutate Canon, Claim truth, NarrativePlan or CreativePolicy.
decisions.rationale: Prevents metric optimization from silently rewriting creative/governance authority.

decisions.title: R2-HOST-001 blocks production provider-reconfiguration during vulnerable I2V recovery
decisions.decision: Before production, persist actual execution identity at provider submission or block affected provider/base-url changes while matching active I2V tasks exist.
decisions.rationale: Mitigates the known ArcReel recovery identity gap documented during R1.8.
